reason: We have run our practice on spreadsheets and WhatsApp groups for a decade without spending a rupee on software. Having article clerks manually forward WhatsApp attachments into another tool is an extra chore on top of an established routine that already works.
objection: Our workflow is cemented in free WhatsApp groups and Excel, and unless client documents are ingested directly from groups without staff having to manually forward them, I will not pay ₹12,990.
would_change_my_mind: Direct automated WhatsApp group ingestion that routes incoming client documents straight to Google Drive without requiring staff to forward or drop files.
